blindComparison: No blind comparison was performed. The source reviewer knows the product identity; these source and Node checks cannot decide which product a blinded evaluator would prefer.
limits: No browser, real WebKit, GPU, device, screenshot or new CI result was produced by this review.
DOM rectangles and styles were substitutes. The predicates do not prove contrast or occlusion by unrelated overlays.
Save-result tests substituted director return values; the new real-browser PLAY, quota rejection, old-byte preservation and reload cases still require execution.
Startup failures before finish is installed may yield only a nonzero process and CI logs rather than JSON. This is a reporting limitation, not demonstrated false success.
Late fault timing remains explicitly not measured; neither this review nor a green measured subset establishes all fault timings.
No blind comparison or change to any of the 19 element verdicts is authorized by this source review.

verification.buildBinding: test:faults rebuilds the production dist from source. The instrument computes currentBuildHash before browser work, uses fresh browser contexts and a no-store dist server, and records commit, browser/version, source+dist build hash and PNG hashes.
verification.launch: Explicit flags disabling browser protections were removed. Chromium keeps only software GL selection arguments; WebKit is launched without those arguments.
